verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch continued his speech, saying: Behold, our father Adam taught these things, and many have believed and become the sons of God, and many have believed not, and have perished in their sins, and are looking forth with fear, in torment, for the fiery indignation of the wrath of God to be poured out upon them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faaauau e Enoka lana lauga, ua faapea atu: Faauta, sa aoao mai e lo tatou tamā o Atamu nei mea, ma e toatele sa talitonu ma ua avea ma atalii o le Atua, ma e toatele sa lē talitonu, ma ua fano ia latou agasala, ma o loo tulimata’i i luma ma le mata’u, i le mafatiaga, mo le matamataita aasa o le toasa o le Atua e oo mai i o latou luga.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And from that time forth Enoch began to prophesy, saying unto the people, that: As I was journeying, and stood upon the place Mahujah, and cried unto the Lord, there came a voice out of heaven, saying—Turn ye, and get ye upon the mount Simeon.
verses.sm: Ma e mai lena taimi ma agai atu i le lumanai na amata ai ona vavalo atu o Enoka, ua fai atu i tagata, e faapea: A’o ou malaga, ma tulai i luga o le nofoaga o Mausa, ma tagi atu i le Alii, sa oo mai ai se siufofoga mai le lagi, ua fetalai mai— Ia e liliu, ma ia e alu i luga o le mauga o Simeona.

verses.en: And it came to pass that I turned and went up on the mount; and as I stood upon the mount, I beheld the heavens open, and I was clothed upon with glory;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa ou liliu ma alu a’e i luga o le mauga; ma a’o ou tulai i luga o le mauga, sa ou vaai atu ua avanoa le lagi, ma sa faaofuina a’u i le mamalu;

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And I saw the Lord; and he stood before my face, and he talked with me, even as a man talketh one with another, face to face; and he said unto me: Look, and I will show unto thee the world for the space of many generations.
verses.sm: Ma sa ou vaai i le Alii; ma sa tulai mai o ia i luma o o’u mata, ma sa talanoa o ia ma a’u, e pei ona talanoa se tagata ma se isi, faafesagai lava; ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: Vaai, ma o le a Ou faaali atu ia te oe le lalolagi i le va o augatupulaga e tele.

verses.en: And it came to pass that I beheld in the valley of Shum, and lo, a great people which dwelt in tents, which were the people of Shum.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ou vaaia le vanu o Suma, ma faauta, o se nuu tele sa nonofo i faleie, le nuu lea o Suma.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And again the Lord said unto me: Look; and I looked towards the north, and I beheld the people of Canaan, which dwelt in tents.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: Vaai; ma sa ou vaai agai atu i matu, ma sa ou vaaia le nuu o Kanana, o e sa nonofo i faleie.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: Prophesy; and I prophesied, saying: Behold the people of Canaan, which are numerous, shall go forth in battle array against the people of Shum, and shall slay them that they shall utterly be destroyed; and the people of Canaan shall divide themselves in the land, and the land shall be barren and unfruitful, and none other people shall dwell there but the people of Canaan;
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: Vavalo atu; ma sa ou vavalo, ua faapea atu: Faauta o le nuu o Kanana, o e ua toatele, o le a o atu e tau faasaga i le nuu o Suma, ma o le a latou fasioti ia i latou ina ia matua faaumatia atoa ai i latou; ma o le a vaevaeina e le nuu o Kanana i latou lava i le laueleele, ma o le a lafulafua le laueleele ma lē fua mai, ma o le a leai se isi nuu e nonofo iina ae na’o le nuu o Kanana;

verses.en: For behold, the Lord shall curse the land with much heat, and the barrenness thereof shall go forth forever; and there was a blackness came upon all the children of Canaan, that they were despised among all people.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o le a fetuu e le Alii le laueleele i le vevela tele, ma o lona lafulafua o le a oo atu e faavavau; ma sa i ai se faauliuli na oo mai i luga o le fanauga uma a Kanana, sa inosia ai i latou i totonu o tagata uma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord said unto me: Look; and I looked, and I beheld the land of Sharon, and the land of Enoch, and the land of Omner, and the land of Heni, and the land of Shem, and the land of Haner, and the land of Hanannihah, and all the inhabitants thereof;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: Vaai; ma sa ou vaai, ma sa ou iloa atu le laueleele o Sarona, ma le laueleele o Enoka, ma le laueleele o Ominara, ma le laueleele o Heni, ma le laueleele o Semu, ma le laueleele o Hana, ma le laueleele o Hananaia, ma e uma o nonofo ai;

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: Go to this people, and say unto them—Repent, lest I come out and smite them with a curse, and they die.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: Alu atu i lenei nuu, ma fai atu ia te i latou— Ia salamo, ne’i Ou alu atu ma taia i latou i se fetuu, ma latou feoti ai.

verses.en: And he gave unto me a commandment that I should baptize in the name of the Father, and of the Son, which is full of grace and truth, and of the Holy Ghost, which beareth record of the Father and the Son.
verses.sm: Ma sa ia tuu mai ia te a’u se poloaiga e tatau ona ou papatiso atu i le suafa o le Tamā, ma le Alo, o lē ua tumu i le alofa tunoa ma le upumoni, ma le Agaga Paia, o lē e molimau e uiga i le Tamā ma le Alo.

w.en: in the name of the Father,

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch continued to call upon all the people, save it were the people of Canaan, to repent;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faaauau ona valaau atu o Enoka i tagata uma, vagana ai le nuu o Kanana, ia salamo;

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And so great was the faith of Enoch that he led the people of God, and their enemies came to battle against them; and he spake the word of the Lord, and the earth trembled, and the mountains fled, even according to his command; and the rivers of water were turned out of their course; and the roar of the lions was heard out of the wilderness; and all nations feared greatly, so powerful was the word of Enoch, and so great was the power of the language which God had given him.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona matua tele lava le faatuatua o Enoka sa ia taitaia ai le nuu o le Atua, ma sa o mai o latou fili e tau faasaga mai ia te i latou; ma sa ia fetalai atu le afioga a le Alii, ma sa gatete le laueleele, ma mou ese atu mauga, e tusa ai ma lana faatonuga; ma sa liliu ese vaitafe mai i o latou alatafe; ma sa faalogoina le tagi a leona mai le vao; ma sa matata’u tele atunuu uma, ona o le mamana tele o le upu a Enoka, ma ona o le matua tele o le mana o le gagana na tuu mai e le Atua ia te ia.

verses.en: There also came up a land out of the depth of the sea, and so great was the fear of the enemies of the people of God, that they fled and stood afar off and went upon the land which came up out of the depth of the sea.
verses.sm: Sa alu a’e foi i luga se laueleele mai le loloto o le sami, ma sa faapea ona matua tele lava le matata’u o fili o le nuu o le Atua, sa oo ina latou sosola ma tutulai mamao ese ma o atu i luga o le laueleele na alu a’e mai le loloto o le sami.

verses.en: And the giants of the land, also, stood afar off; and there went forth a curse upon all people that fought against God;
verses.sm: Ma o tagata tino ese o le laueleele, sa tutulai mamao ese foi; ma sa oo atu se fetuu i luga o tagata uma sa faasagatau i le Atua;

verses.en: And from that time forth there were wars and bloodshed among them; but the Lord came and dwelt with his people, and they dwelt in righteousness.
verses.sm: Ma e mai lena taimi ma le agai atu i le lumanai sa i ai taua ma le faamasaatoto i totonu o i latou; ae sa afio mai le Alii ma mau faatasi ma lona nuu, ma sa latou ola ai i le amiotonu.

verses.en: The fear of the Lord was upon all nations, so great was the glory of the Lord, which was upon his people. And the Lord blessed the land, and they were blessed upon the mountains, and upon the high places, and did flourish.
verses.sm: Sa i luga o atunuu uma le mata’u i le Alii, ona sa matua tele lava le mamalu o le Alii, sa i luga o lona nuu. Ma sa faamanuia e le Alii le laueleele, ma sa faamanuiaina i latou i luga o mauga, ma i luga o mea maualuluga, ma sa uluuluola.

verses.en: And the Lord called his people ZION, because they were of one heart and one mind, and dwelt in righteousness; and there was no poor among them.
verses.sm: Ma sa ta’ua e le Alii lona nuu o Siona, ona sa tasi o latou loto ma tasi le mafaufau, ma sa mau i le amiotonu; ma sa leai se mativa i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: And Enoch continued his preaching in righteousness unto the people of God. And it came to pass in his days, that he built a city that was called the City of Holiness, even ZION.
verses.sm: Ma sa faaauau e Enoka lana talaiga i le amiotonu i le nuu o le Atua. Ma sa oo i ona aso, sa fausia e ia se aai sa ta’ua o le Aai Paia, o Siona lava.

w.en: And it came to pass in

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch talked with the Lord; and he said unto the Lord: Surely Zion shall dwell in safety forever. But the Lord said unto Enoch: Zion have I blessed, but the residue of the people have I cursed.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina talatala Enoka faatasi ma le Alii; ma sa fai atu o ia i le Alii: E moni lava o le a mau Siona i le saogalemu e faavavau. Ae sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Ua Ou faamanuiaina Siona, ae o le vaega o totoe o tagata ua Ou fetuuina.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord showed unto Enoch all the inhabitants of the earth; and he beheld, and lo, Zion, in process of time, was taken up into heaven. And the Lord said unto Enoch: Behold mine abode forever.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faaali mai e le Alii ia Enoka tagata uma e nonofo i le lalolagi; ma sa vaai atu o ia, ma faauta, o Siona, i le taualumaga o le taimi, ua aveina a’e i le lagi. Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Faauta i lo’u nofoaga e faavavau.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And Enoch also beheld the residue of the people which were the sons of Adam; and they were a mixture of all the seed of Adam save it was the seed of Cain, for the seed of Cain were black, and had not place among them.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai foi Enoka i le vaega na totoe o tagata o e o atalii o Atamu; ma o i latou o se tuufaatasiga fefiloi o fanau uma a Atamu vagana ai le fanau a Kaino, ona o fanau a Kaino sa uli, ma sa leai se nofoaga i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: And after that Zion was taken up into heaven, Enoch beheld, and lo, all the nations of the earth were before him;
verses.sm: Ma ina ua mavae ona aveina a’e o Siona i le lagi, sa vaai atu Enoka, ma faauta, ua i ona luma atunuu uma o le lalolagi;

verses.en: And there came generation upon generation; and Enoch was high and lifted up, even in the bosom of the Father, and of the Son of Man; and behold, the power of Satan was upon all the face of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo mai i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga; ma sa maualuga Enoka ma sa siitia a’e, i le loto lava o le Tamā, ma le Atalii o le Tagata; ma faauta, sa i luga o le lalolagi atoa le mana o Satani.

verses.en: And he saw angels descending out of heaven; and he heard a loud voice saying: Wo, wo be unto the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai o ia i agelu ua afifio ifo mai le lagi; ma sa ia faalogoina se siufofoga leo tele ua fetalai mai: Oi talofa, oi talofa i e o nonofo i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And he beheld Satan; and he had a great chain in his hand, and it veiled the whole face of the earth with darkness; and he looked up and laughed, and his angels rejoiced.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai o ia ia Satani; ma sa i ai ia te ia se filifili tele i lona lima, ma sa ufitia ai luga o le lalolagi atoa i le pouliuli; ma sa tepa a’e o ia ma ’ata, ma sa olioli ana agelu.

verses.en: And Enoch beheld angels descending out of heaven, bearing testimony of the Father and Son; and the Holy Ghost fell on many, and they were caught up by the powers of heaven into Zion.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaaia e Enoka agelu ua afifio ifo mai le lagi, ua molimau atu e uiga i le Tamā ma le Alo; ma sa afio ifo le Agaga Paia i luga o le toatele, ma sa segia a’e i latou i luga i Siona e mana o le lagi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the God of heaven looked upon the residue of the people, and he wept; and Enoch bore record of it, saying: How is it that the heavens weep, and shed forth their tears as the rain upon the mountains?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina silasila ifo le Atua o le lagi i luga o e na totoe o le nuu, ma sa tutulu o ia; ma sa molimauina e Enoka lea mea, ua fai mai: Pe ua faapefea ea ona tutulu o le lagi, ma faamaligi ifo o latou loifofoga e pei o uaga i luga o mauga?

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And Enoch said unto the Lord: How is it that thou canst weep, seeing thou art holy, and from all eternity to all eternity?
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Enoka i le Alii: Pe ua mafai faapefea ona e tutulu, ona ua vaai ua e paia, ma ua mai le faavavau atoa i le faavavau atoa?

verses.en: And were it possible that man could number the particles of the earth, yea, millions of earths like this, it would not be a beginning to the number of thy creations; and thy curtains are stretched out still; and yet thou art there, and thy bosom is there; and also thou art just; thou art merciful and kind forever;
verses.sm: Ma a na mafai e le tagata ona faitau vaega itiiti o le lalolagi, ioe, le miliona o lalolagi e pei o lenei, e lē mafai ona avea o se amataga i le atoaga o au foafoaga; ae ua toso atu pea ou ie pupuni; ma peitai o loo i ai oe iina, ma ua i ai iina lou loto; ma ua e fai mea tonu foi; ua e alofa mutimutivale ma agalelei e faavavau;

verses.en: And thou hast taken Zion to thine own bosom, from all thy creations, from all eternity to all eternity; and naught but peace, justice, and truth is the habitation of thy throne; and mercy shall go before thy face and have no end; how is it thou canst weep?
verses.sm: Ma ua e avea Siona i lou lava loto, mai au foafoaga uma, e mai le faavavau atoa i le faavavau atoa; ma ua leai se mea ae ua nao le filemu, faamasinotonu, ma le upumoni le afioaga o lou nofoaalii; ma o le a alu atu le alofamutimutivale i luma o ou fofoga ma e leai se gataaga; pe ua mafai faapefea ona e tutulu?

verses.en: The Lord said unto Enoch: Behold these thy brethren; they are the workmanship of mine own hands, and I gave unto them their knowledge, in the day I created them; and in the Garden of Eden, gave I unto man his agency;
verses.sm: Sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Faauta ia i latou nei o ou uso; o i latou o galuega a o’u lava lima, ma sa Ou tuu atu ia te i latou lo latou malamalama, i le aso na Ou foafoa ai i latou; ma sa Ou tuu atu i le tagata i le Faatoaga o Etena, lona faitalia;

verses.en: And unto thy brethren have I said, and also given commandment, that they should love one another, and that they should choose me, their Father; but behold, they are without affection, and they hate their own blood;
verses.sm: Ma sa Ou fai atu i ou uso, ma tuuina atu foi le poloaiga, e tatau ona latou alolofa o le tasi i le isi, ma e tatau ona latou filifili a’u, lo latou Tamā; ae faauta, ua aunoa i latou ma le alofa, ma ua latou inoino i o latou lava toto;

verses.en: And the fire of mine indignation is kindled against them; and in my hot displeasure will I send in the floods upon them, for my fierce anger is kindled against them.
verses.sm: Ma ua sasao a’e le afi o lo’u ita e faasaga ia te i latou; ma o le aasa o lo’u lē fiafia o le a Ou auina atu ai lolo i luga o i latou, ona ua sasao a’e lo’u ita tele e faasaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: Behold, I am God; Man of Holiness is my name; Man of Counsel is my name; and Endless and Eternal is my name, also.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o le Atua; o le Tagata Paia o lo’u igoa lea; o le Tagata Fautua o lo’u igoa lea; ma o Lē Gata ma Faavavau o lo’u igoa foi lea.

verses.en: Wherefore, I can stretch forth mine hands and hold all the creations which I have made; and mine eye can pierce them also, and among all the workmanship of mine hands there has not been so great wickedness as among thy brethren.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e mafai ona faaloloa atu o’u lima ma umia foafoaga uma ua Ou faia; ma e mafai foi ona ati lau vaai ia te i latou; ma i totonu o galuega uma a o’u lima sa le’i i ai lava se amioleaga tele e pei ona i ai i totonu o ou uso.

verses.en: But behold, their sins shall be upon the heads of their fathers; Satan shall be their father, and misery shall be their doom; and the whole heavens shall weep over them, even all the workmanship of mine hands; wherefore should not the heavens weep, seeing these shall suffer?
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o a latou agasala o le a i luga o ulu o o latou tamā; o le a avea Satani ma o latou tamā, ma o le a avea le pagatia ma o latou malaia; ma o le a tutulu le lagi atoa i luga o i latou, o le galuega atoa lava a o’u lima; o le mea lea, pe ua lē tatau ea ona tutulu o le lagi, i le vaai atu o le a mafatia i latou nei?

verses.en: But behold, these which thine eyes are upon shall perish in the floods; and behold, I will shut them up; a prison have I prepared for them.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o i latou ia o loo silasila atu i ai i luga ou fofoga o le a fano i lologa; ma faauta, o le a Ou tapunia i latou; ua Ou saunia se falepuipui mo i latou.

verses.en: And that which I have chosen hath pled before my face. Wherefore, he suffereth for their sins; inasmuch as they will repent in the day that my Chosen shall return unto me, and until that day they shall be in torment;
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē ua Ou filifilia ua aioi mai i luma o o’u mata. O le mea lea, ua mafatia o ia mo a latou agasala; e tusa ai ma lo latou salamo i le aso e foi mai ai la’u Au Filifilia ia te a’u, ma seia oo mai lena aso, o le a latou i ai i mafatiga;

verses.en: Wherefore, for this shall the heavens weep, yea, and all the workmanship of mine hands.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ona o lenei mea o le a tutulu ai le lagi, ioe, ma galuega uma a o’u lima.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord spake unto Enoch, and told Enoch all the doings of the children of men; wherefore Enoch knew, and looked upon their wickedness, and their misery, and wept and stretched forth his arms, and his heart swelled wide as eternity; and his bowels yearned; and all eternity shook.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka, ma ta’u mai ia Enoka mea uma ua faia e le fanauga a tagata; o le mea lea na iloa ai e Enoka, ma sa vaai atu i lo latou amioleaga, ma lo latou pagatia, ma ua tagi ma faaloloa atu ona lima, ma sa fefete naua lona loto e pei o le faavavau, ma mutimutivale ona lagona; ma sa luluina le faavavau atoa.

verses.en: And Enoch also saw Noah, and his family; that the posterity of all the sons of Noah should be saved with a temporal salvation;
verses.sm: Ma sa vaai foi Enoka ia Noa, ma lona aiga; e faapea o le a laveaiina fanau a atalii uma o Noa i se faaolataga faaletino;

verses.en: Wherefore Enoch saw that Noah built an ark; and that the Lord smiled upon it, and held it in his own hand; but upon the residue of the wicked the floods came and swallowed them up.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na vaai ai Enoka sa fausia e Noa se vaa; ma sa fiafia le Alii i le vaa, ma umia i lona lava aao; ae o e na totoe o e na amioleaga na oo mai i ai lolo ma tofatumoanaina i latou.

verses.en: And as Enoch saw this, he had bitterness of soul, and wept over his brethren, and said unto the heavens: I will refuse to be comforted; but the Lord said unto Enoch: Lift up your heart, and be glad; and look.
verses.sm: Ma a’o vaai atu Enoka i lenei mea, sa ia te ia le faanoanoa o le agaga, ma tagi e uiga i ona uso, ma fai atu i le lagi: O le a ou musu e faamafanafanaina; ae na fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Ia siitia a’e lou loto, ma fiafia; ma vaai.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch looked; and from Noah, he beheld all the families of the earth; and he cried unto the Lord, saying: When shall the day of the Lord come? When shall the blood of the Righteous be shed, that all they that mourn may be sanctified and have eternal life?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina vaai atu Enoka; ma sa iloa e ia aiga uma o le lalolagi mai ia Noa; ma sa tagi atu o ia i le Alii, ua fai atu: O afea e oo mai ai le aso o le Alii? O afea e faamaligi ai le toto o le Amiotonu ina ia mafai ona faapaiaina ma maua le ola e faavavau e i latou uma o e e faanoanoa?

w.en: And it came to pass that
all the kindreds of the earth.

verses.en: And the Lord said: It shall be in the meridian of time, in the days of wickedness and vengeance.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii: O le a i le vaeluaga o taimi, i aso o le amioleaga ma le tauimasui.

verses.en: And behold, Enoch saw the day of the coming of the Son of Man, even in the flesh; and his soul rejoiced, saying: The Righteous is lifted up, and the Lamb is slain from the foundation of the world; and through faith I am in the bosom of the Father, and behold, Zion is with me.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, sa vaai Enoka i le aso o le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata, i le tino lava; ma sa olioli lona agaga, ua fai mai: Ua sii i luga le Amiotonu, ma ua fasia le Tamai Mamoe mai le faavaega o le lalolagi; ma ua ou i ai i le loto o le Tamā e ala i le faatuatua, ma faauta, ua faatasi Siona ma a’u.

w.en: from the foundation of the world,

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch looked upon the earth; and he heard a voice from the bowels thereof, saying: Wo, wo is me, the mother of men; I am pained, I am weary, because of the wickedness of my children. When shall I rest, and be cleansed from the filthiness which is gone forth out of me? When will my Creator sanctify me, that I may rest, and righteousness for a season abide upon my face?
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina vaai atu Enoka i le lalolagi; ma sa ia faalogoina se leo mai le manava o le eleele, ua faapea mai: Oi talofa, oi talofa ia te a’u, le tinā o tagata; ua ou tiga, ua ou vaivai, ona o le amioleaga o la’u fanau. O afea ea ou te mapu ai, ma faamamaina mai le eleelea ua tea atu mai ia te a’u? O afea ea e faapaiaina ai a’u e lo’u Foafoa, ina ia ou mapu, ma mau ai le amiotonu i o’u luga mo se vaitau?

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And when Enoch heard the earth mourn, he wept, and cried unto the Lord, saying: O Lord, wilt thou not have compassion upon the earth? Wilt thou not bless the children of Noah?
verses.sm: Ma ina ua faalogo atu Enoka i le faanoanoa o le lalolagi, sa tutulu o ia, ma tagi atu i le Alii, ua fai atu: Le Alii e, pe e te lē agaalofa ea i le lalolagi? Pe e te lē faamanuiaina ea le fanau a Noa?

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch continued his cry unto the Lord, saying: I ask thee, O Lord, in the name of thine Only Begotten, even Jesus Christ, that thou wilt have mercy upon Noah and his seed, that the earth might never more be covered by the floods.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faaauau e Enoka lana tagi atu i le Alii, ua fai atu: Ou te ole atu ia te oe, Le Alii e, i le suafa o lau Toatasi na Fanaua, o Iesu Keriso lava, ia e alofa mutimutivale ia Noa ma lana fanau, ina ia lē toe ufitia le lalolagi i lolo.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Lord could not withhold; and he covenanted with Enoch, and sware unto him with an oath, that he would stay the floods; that he would call upon the children of Noah;
verses.sm: Ma sa lē mafai e le Alii ona taofia; ma sa osifeagaiga o ia ma Enoka, ma tauto mai ia te ia i se tautoga, o le a ia taofi lolo; o le a ia valaau atu i fanau a Noa;

verses.en: And he sent forth an unalterable decree, that a remnant of his seed should always be found among all nations, while the earth should stand;
verses.sm: Ma sa ia auina atu se poloaiga lē masuia, o le a i ai pea se vaega o totoe o ana fanau o le a i ai i atunuu uma, a’o i ai pea le lalolagi;

verses.en: And the Lord said: Blessed is he through whose seed Messiah shall come; for he saith—I am Messiah, the King of Zion, the Rock of Heaven, which is broad as eternity; whoso cometh in at the gate and climbeth up by me shall never fall; wherefore, blessed are they of whom I have spoken, for they shall come forth with songs of everlasting joy.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii: Amuia lava o ia o lē o le a ala mai i ana fanau le afio mai o le Mesia; ona ua fetalai mai o ia— o A’u o le Mesia, o le Tupu o Siona, o le Papa o le Lagi, ua lautele e pei o le faavavau; ai se e sau i totonu i le faitotoa ma ’a’e mai i luga e ala ia te a’u, e lē pa’ū lava; o le mea lea, amuia lava i latou o e ua Ou fai atu ai, ona o le a latou o mai ma pese o le olioli e faavavau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch cried unto the Lord, saying: When the Son of Man cometh in the flesh, shall the earth rest? I pray thee, show me these things.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tagi atu Enoka i le Alii, ua fai atu: A afio mai le Atalii o le Tagata i le tino, e mapu ea le lalolagi? Ou te talosaga atu ia te oe, faaali mai ia te a’u ia mea.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Enoch: Look, and he looked and beheld the Son of Man lifted up on the cross, after the manner of men;
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Vaai, ma sa vaai o ia ma vaai atu i le Atalii o le Tagata ua sii a’e i luga o le satauro, e tusa ma le tu a tagata;

verses.en: And he heard a loud voice; and the heavens were veiled; and all the creations of God mourned; and the earth groaned; and the rocks were rent; and the saints arose, and were crowned at the right hand of the Son of Man, with crowns of glory;
verses.sm: Ma sa ia faalogoina se siufofoga leotele; ma sa tapunia le lagi; ma sa aue foafoaga uma a le Atua; ma sa oi le lalolagi; ma sa mavaevae papa; ma sa tutulai mai le au paia, ma sa faapaleina i le aao taumatau o le Atalii o le Tagata, i palealii o le mamalu;

verses.en: And as many of the spirits as were in prison came forth, and stood on the right hand of God; and the remainder were reserved in chains of darkness until the judgment of the great day.
verses.sm: Ma o le toatele o agaga sa i ai i le falepuipui sa o mai, ma laulaututu i le aao taumatau o le Atua; a’o le vaega na totoe sa faapolopolo i filifili o le pouliuli seia oo i le faamasinoga o le aso tele.

verses.en: And again Enoch wept and cried unto the Lord, saying: When shall the earth rest?
verses.sm: Ma sa toe tutulu Enoka ma tagi atu i le Alii, ua fai atu: O afea ea e mapu ai le lalolagi?

verses.en: And Enoch beheld the Son of Man ascend up unto the Father; and he called unto the Lord, saying: Wilt thou not come again upon the earth? Forasmuch as thou art God, and I know thee, and thou hast sworn unto me, and commanded me that I should ask in the name of thine Only Begotten; thou hast made me, and given unto me a right to thy throne, and not of myself, but through thine own grace; wherefore, I ask thee if thou wilt not come again on the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa vaaia e Enoka le Atalii o le Tagata ua afio a’e i le Tamā; ma sa valaau atu o ia i le Alii, ua fai atu: Pe e te lē toe afio mai ea i le lalolagi? Talu ai ona o oe o le Atua, ma ua ou iloa oe, ma sa e tauto mai ia te a’u, ma poloaiina a’u ia ou ole atu i le suafa o lau Toatasi na Fanaua; na e faia a’u, ma tuu mai ia te a’u se aiā i lou nofoalii, ma e lē ona o a’u lava, ae e ala i lou lava alofa tunoa; o le mea lea, ou te fesili atu ai ia te oe pe e te lē toe afio mai i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Enoch: As I live, even so will I come in the last days, in the days of wickedness and vengeance, to fulfil the oath which I have made unto you concerning the children of Noah;
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: E pei ona Ou ola, o le a faapea lava ona Ou alu atu i aso e gata ai, i aso o le amioleaga ma le tauimasui, e faataunuu le tautoga na Ou faia ia te oe e uiga i le fanau a Noa;

verses.en: And the day shall come that the earth shall rest, but before that day the heavens shall be darkened, and a veil of darkness shall cover the earth; and the heavens shall shake, and also the earth; and great tribulations shall be among the children of men, but my people will I preserve;
verses.sm: Ma o le a oo mai le aso o le a mapu ai le lalolagi, peitai ae lei oo mai lena aso o le a faapouliuligia le lagi, ma o le a ufitia le lalolagi i se veli o le pogisa; ma o le a luluina le lagi, ma le lalolagi foi; ma o le a i ai puapuaga e tele i totonu o le fanauga a tagata, ae o lo’u nuu o le a Ou faasaoina;

verses.en: And righteousness will I send down out of heaven; and truth will I send forth out of the earth, to bear testimony of mine Only Begotten; his resurrection from the dead; yea, and also the resurrection of all men; and righteousness and truth will I cause to sweep the earth as with a flood, to gather out mine elect from the four quarters of the earth, unto a place which I shall prepare, an Holy City, that my people may gird up their loins, and be looking forth for the time of my coming; for there shall be my tabernacle, and it shall be called Zion, a New Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou auina ifo i lalo mai le lagi le amiotonu; ma o le a Ou auina atu le upumoni mai le eleele, e molimau atu i la’u Toatasi na Fanaua; lona toetu mai le maliu; ioe, ma le toetutu mai foi o tagata uma; ma o le a Ou faia ia tafia le lalolagi i le amiotonu ma le upumoni e pei o se lolo, e faapotopoto mai i fafo la’u au filifilia mai itu e fa o le lalolagi, i se nofoaga o le a Ou saunia, o se Aai Paia, ina ia mafai e lo’u nuu ona fusia i o latou sulugatiti, ma tulimatai i le taimi o lo’u alu atu; ona o iina o le a i ai lo’u fale fetafai, ma o le a ta’ua ai o Siona, o se Ierusalema Fou.

w.en: from the four quarters of the earth;

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Enoch: Then shalt thou and all thy city meet them there, and we will receive them into our bosom, and they shall see us; and we will fall upon their necks, and they shall fall upon our necks, and we will kiss each other;
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Enoka: Ona feiloa’i ai lea o oe ma lou aai atoa ma i latou iina, ma o le a tatou talia i latou i o tatou loto, ma o le a latou vaai mai ia te i tatou; ma o le a tatou fusi i o latou ua, ma o le a latou fusi foi i o tatou ua, ma o le a tatou feasogi foi le tasi i le isi;

verses.en: And there shall be mine abode, and it shall be Zion, which shall come forth out of all the creations which I have made; and for the space of a thousand years the earth shall rest.
verses.sm: Ma o le a iina lo’u nofoaga, ma o le a avea ma Siona, lea o le a sau mai foafoaga uma ua Ou faia; ma o le a mapu le lalolagi i va o le afe tausaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Enoch saw the day of the coming of the Son of Man, in the last days, to dwell on the earth in righteousness for the space of a thousand years;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina vaai Enoka i le aso o le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata, i aso e gata ai, e afio i le lalolagi i le amiotonu i le va o le afe tausaga;

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: But before that day he saw great tribulations among the wicked; and he also saw the sea, that it was troubled, and men's hearts failing them, looking forth with fear for the judgments of the Almighty God, which should come upon the wicked.
verses.sm: Peitai ae lei oo mai lena aso, sa vaai o ia i puapuaga tetele i totonu o e ua amioleaga; ma sa vaai foi o ia i le sami, ua loulouā, ma loto o tagata ua faavaivai, ua tulimatai i luma ma le matata’u i faamasinoga a le Atua Malosi Aoao, o le a oo mai i luga o e ua amioleaga.

verses.en: And the Lord showed Enoch all things, even unto the end of the world; and he saw the day of the righteous, the hour of their redemption, and received a fulness of joy;
verses.sm: Ma sa faaali mai e le Alii ia Enoka mea uma, e oo lava i le gataaga o le lalolagi; ma sa vaai o ia i le aso o e ua amiotonu, le itula o lo latou togiolaina, ma maua se atoatoaga o le olioli;

verses.en: And all the days of Zion, in the days of Enoch, were three hundred and sixty-five years.
verses.sm: Ma o aso uma o Siona, i aso o Enoka, e tolu selau onosefulu ma le lima tausaga.

verses.en: And Enoch and all his people walked with God, and he dwelt in the midst of Zion; and it came to pass that Zion was not, for God received it up into his own bosom; and from thence went forth the saying, ZION IS FLED.
verses.sm: Ma sa savavali Enoka ma lona nuu atoa faatasi ma le Atua, ma sa afio o ia i le lotolotoi o Siona; ma sa oo ina lē toe i ai Siona, ona ua aveina a’e i luga e le Atua i lona lava loto; ma mai i le taimi lena na alu atu ai le upu, Ua sola Siona.

w.en: And it came to pass that
